assertions.issues: NARROW FAILURE — everything in the round-1 defect is fixed (raw reservation-status and course enums now render Arabic: محجوز/مؤكد/وصل/جالس/منتهي/لم يحضر/ملغى, course طبق رئيسي, plus VIP/occasion/dietary/late-risk and the conflict reason تداخل الطاولات), dir=rtl/lang=ar hold, numbers/codes/times/phones render LTR with no reversal, zero console errors. The remaining defect: on the Arabic Book list the contact-status badge for rsv_acme_1 renders English 'Left message'. Root cause: apps/app/app/utils/reservations/labels.ts CONTACT_STATUS_LABELS keys are left_voicemail/confirmed_by_phone/sms_sent/none, but the canonical contact_status vocabulary is left_message | no_answer | wrong_number (architecture.md:716; packages/tenant-db/src/schema.ts:2974; apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-booking-service.ts:2941). enumLabel() falls back to humanizeEnum() -> 'Left message' in the Arabic UI (and would render 'No answer'/'Wrong number' too). Repro: DB has contact_status='left_message' for rsv_acme_1; book.tsx:512 renders label(CONTACT_STATUS_LABELS, rsv.contactStatus). The same key mismatch also means the detail sheet's Contact Tracking selector (detail-sheet.tsx:61-68) has no option for the value the backend stores.

summary: Re-tested 4 assertions + 1 optional spot-check on the round-2 build. VAL-BOOK-011 pass: my booked/seated/cancelled parties drove Upcoming/Seated/Finished badges 1/3/1 exactly matching sqlite, and the Seat quick action (POST status 200) moved the row and updated counters immediately. VAL-BOOK-012 pass: an overbooked overlap (R2Today Conflict A+B on G9-3, overbook=1 occupancy) showed as 'Unassigned & Conflicts 1', the panel rendered the entry properly (round-1 mapping defect fixed), clicking Details opened ?r=rsv_73c7321f, and GET /book/conflicts -> 200 lists the table_overlap. VAL-BOOK-006 pass: walk-in seated immediately on the walk_in_only table G9-1 (POST walk-ins 201; sqlite seated/walk_in/covers_actual=2/active occupancy; availability never suggests G9-1). VAL-BOOK-037 FAIL (narrow): all round-1 raw status/course enums are now Arabic (محجوز/مؤكد/وصل/جالس/منتهي/لم يحضر/ملغى, course طبق رئيسي, conflict تداخل الطاولات), dir=rtl/lang=ar hold on Today/Book/detail sheet, codes/times/phones/party numbers render LTR without reversal, zero console errors — but the contact-status badge still renders English 'Left message' on the Arabic Book list because labels.ts CONTACT_STATUS_LABELS keys (left_voicemail/confirmed_by_phone/sms_sent) do not match the canonical values left_message/no_answer/wrong_number (architecture.md:716), so humanizeEnum falls back to English. Optional KSA spot-check: both KSA pages load in Arabic and every browser /operator/reservations/book/* request went to localhost:3009 with zero cross-routing.
